independentMemory.formula: M = ordinary_displacement_links + retroflex_links + YW_nonidentity_links + AEO_carriers + nonidentity_final_links + initial_extra_routes + final_extra_routes
independentMemory.scope: common399; normalized written tails with j/q/x/Y-u restored as v; er explicit; iu/ui/un retained
independentMemory.policy: Each nonidentity mapping costs one. An ordinary displaced initial is already charged; no second default fee. A/E/O shared physical carrier counted once. Every additional key within a head/final costs one routing item. Optional aliases included only where authoritative source is supplied.
